**Family dispatch — fold-or-serial answered: FOLD** (gates on the anchor per the comment-slimming protocol; members carry one-line pointers).
- Gate ① same defect shape & fix: all three are "H8's input set is too narrow — widen what the predicate sees" (branch names it ignores; closed cards it never revisits; open PRs delivering the same card it cannot consult). One predicate, one script, one dispatch.
- Gate ② same file/area: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.
- Gate ③ all graded to queue in the 2026-08-22 concentrated round, each with its chosen scope in its grading comment.
- Gate ④ per-member criteria, one commit each, one `Fixes #<n>` line each:
  - this card — branch-name fallback: a merged PR whose head ref matches the issue-branch pattern counts as delivering that card even when the body carries neither recognised spelling; self-test in BOTH directions (a hit reports; a re-scoped branch does not).
  - the closed-card member — a bounded recently-closed sweep for `pm:*` residue as its own H-row (direction A of its card), plus a one-time backfill of the remaining ~104 closed carriers (the 25 devx ones are already clean).
  - the half-delivered member — H8 receives the open-PR list the sweep already holds and suppresses (or downgrades to a distinct quieter row, implementer's call with the abandoned-last-half caveat carried) when an open PR delivers the same card by the same targets test.
- Gate ⑤ exclusion list: the commit-message closing-keyword card (new surface, report-only measure-first — not this predicate); the `Blocked-by`-comments tracking card (different predicate, os-warren's tracking card, not touched).
